annotation.title_clean: Directive 2009/104/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 September 2009 concerning the minimum safety and health requirements for the use of work equipment by workers at work
annotation.title_en: Directive 2009/104/EC concerning the minimum safety and health requirements for the use of work equipment by workers at work
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union L 260
annotation.summary_en: Codified EU directive setting minimum safety and health requirements for workers' use of work equipment: employer obligations, inspection, training, information, and technical annexes on controls, guards, mobile and lifting equipment, and work at height. It does not mention AI or robots; it is only tangentially relevant to physical machine safety.
key_provisions_or_claims: Employers must provide suitable work equipment and minimise residual risks.
Equipment must comply with relevant EU directives or Annex I minimum requirements and be maintained.
Initial, periodic and special inspections are required, with records kept.
Workers must receive adequate information, instructions and training.
Annex I sets requirements for controls, emergency stop, guards, and mobile and remote-controlled equipment.
